title: Single-Qubit Gates

content.statement: Unitary 2×2 matrices that rotate the state on the Bloch sphere.
content.explanation: All single‑qubit gates are rotations around axes. The Pauli matrices (X,Y,Z), Hadamard (H), phase gates (S,T), and rotation gates (R_x, R_y, R_z) form the basic set.
content.example: X gate is a NOT gate: X|0⟩=|1⟩, X|1⟩=|0⟩.
keyTakeaways: Unitary 2×2 matrices that rotate the state on the Bloch sphere.

content.statement: Gates acting on two or more qubits, such as CNOT, CZ, SWAP, Toffoli, and Fredkin.
content.explanation: CNOT flips the target if the control is |1⟩. CZ applies a Z gate to the target conditioned on the control. SWAP exchanges two qubits. Toffoli and Fredkin are universal for reversible classical computation.
keyTakeaways: Gates acting on two or more qubits, such as CNOT, CZ, SWAP, Toffoli, and Fredkin.

content.statement: Reversible computation, unitary transformations, universal gate sets, and the Solovay‑Kitaev theorem.
content.explanation: All quantum gates are unitary and hence reversible. A universal gate set (e.g., {H, T, CNOT}) can approximate any unitary operation. The Solovay‑Kitaev theorem guarantees efficient approximation with overhead polylog(1/ε).
content.example: {H, T, CNOT} is universal; {Toffoli} alone is universal for classical reversible circuits.
keyTakeaways: Reversible computation, unitary transformations, universal gate sets, and the Solovay‑Kitaev theorem.
Know what problem or physical phenomenon 6.3 Concepts addresses.

formulas.latex: U†U = I; Solovay‑Kitaev: any U can be approximated with O(log^c(1/ε)) gates.

content.statement: Any single‑qubit gate can be decomposed as U = e^{iα} R_z(β) R_y(γ) R_z(δ) (Euler angles).
content.explanation: This Z‑Y‑Z decomposition is useful for implementing arbitrary rotations on hardware. CNOT and single‑qubit gates together form a universal set.
content.example: H = R_z(π) R_y(π/2) R_z(0) up to global phase.
keyTakeaways: Any single‑qubit gate can be decomposed as U = e^{iα} R_z(β) R_y(γ) R_z(δ) (Euler angles).
